TreeLayout & style

The `m3e-tree` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.tree []
[ M3e.treeItem [ M3e.TreeItem.open True ]
[ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Getting Started")
, M3e.treeItem [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Overview") ]
, M3e.treeItem [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Installation") ]
]
, M3e.treeItem []
[ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Components")
, M3e.treeItem [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Button") ]
, M3e.treeItem [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Card") ]
]
]
M3e.Tree.view []
[ M3e.TreeItem.el { label = Kit.text "Getting Started" }
[ M3e.TreeItem.open True ]
[ M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Overview") ]
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Installation") ]
]
, M3e.TreeItem.el { label = Kit.text "Components" }
[]
[ M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Button") ]
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Card") ]
]
]
M3e.Tree.build
|> M3e.Tree.withChild
(M3e.TreeItem.view [ M3e.TreeItem.open True ]
[ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Getting Started")
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Overview") ]
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Installation") ]
]
)
|> M3e.Tree.withChild
(M3e.TreeItem.view []
[ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Components")
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Button") ]
, M3e.TreeItem.view [] [ M3e.TreeItem.label (Kit.text "Card") ]
]
)
|> M3e.Tree.toElement
<m3e-tree>
<m3e-tree-item open>
<span slot="label">Getting Started</span>
<m3e-tree-item>
<span slot="label">Overview</span>
</m3e-tree-item>
<m3e-tree-item>
<span slot="label">Installation</span>
</m3e-tree-item>
</m3e-tree-item>
<m3e-tree-item>
<span slot="label">Components</span>
<m3e-tree-item>
<span slot="label">Button</span>
</m3e-tree-item>
<m3e-tree-item>
<span slot="label">Card</span>
</m3e-tree-item>
</m3e-tree-item>
</m3e-tree>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-tree produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

M3eComponentsBuilderRaw
Constructor
tree : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Internal.Types.Tree.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element M3e.Internal.Types.Tree.Content (M3e.Internal.Types.Tree.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Internal.Types.Tree.Is s) admittedBy msg

See M3e.Component.Tree.component.
